# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.8

This is the deployable release for the restricted PostgreSQL runtime role,
Project Control 2.1, and permanent RX Softphone preservation in NEXT. It
supersedes the failed `v4.0.0-next.7` tag, which published no release assets
and must not be deployed.

## Database security

- The web service can use a restricted login for normal business reads and
  writes without owning tables or receiving schema, role-administration, or
  migration-ledger write privileges.
- Project Control 2.1 prompts an administrator for the existing PostgreSQL
  maintenance login only when an update or rollback needs backup, migration,
  verification, or restore access. It does not store that login in `.env`.
- Installing this release does not automatically change the production
  database login. The one-time runtime-role conversion remains a separate,
  verified administrator step.

## Official Windows assets

- `server-update-4.0.0-next.8.zip` for the RX Tracker server;
- `RxSoftphone-0.4.2-win-x64.zip` for managed calling workstations;
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` covering both ZIPs and the compiled server executables.

The softphone release builder now restores the explicit `win-x64` runtime so
a clean GitHub runner downloads every required self-contained .NET runtime
pack. SIP credentials and production `.env` files are not included.

## Validation

- All 34 audited database migrations and their checksums were verified.
- PostgreSQL lifecycle CI passed on staging, develop, and main.
- A current NEXT production dump was restored only to an isolated local
  database. Aggregate business fingerprints, the seven configured workflow
  actions, authenticated pages, patient/RX writes, Call Center, reports, and
  exports were verified without committing the dump or patient data.
- The server and RX Softphone packages were built and inspected locally; the
  official assets are built again from this tag by GitHub Actions.

**Database impact:** No migration and no automatic data change. Keep the
production `.env` unchanged while installing with Project Control option 15.
Perform the runtime-role conversion only during the separately documented
controlled step.
